exercise.title: Find the note and play it
exercise.why: When the answer is a note you play, your hand has to find the place by itself, so the name gets tied to a feel and not only to a picture.

cells.text:
Press Playing it (mic) under the neck below. Then press Start above the neck. The game names a note and a string: find it on your guitar and play it, and the game hears your answer.
Practice until your finger goes to some of the notes without counting frets.
